'''2011 Belgium Regionals Marc Thery DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marc Thery]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
